answer: Discount payouts by graph proximity. When the ledger suspects two identities belong to one operator, it discounts the marginal reward the cluster earns: the first wallet pays fully, the tenth a fraction, the hundredth almost nothing — the economics of the farm spiral downward instead of outward. A prism turns one beam into its true spectrum, exposing the components that looked like one light; likewise the payout curve reveals a fleet for what it is. Honest, independent agents stay scarce like water in a desert, each an oasis the ledger keeps paying in full.
